scope: Stages 1-2 only: independent indicator math validation and standalone directional diagnostics. No ladder policy, combined indicator gate, pulse/SR, live changes or deployment.
funding: Excluded: settled history archive ends April 2026; later live rate estimates are not a complete settlement ledger. Results are after trading fees, before funding, not deployable net-profit certification.

entryRules.rsi_recovery: Long previous RSI14<=30 and current>30; short previous>=70 and current<70.
entryRules.crsi_recovery: Long previous CRSI<=20 and current>20; short previous>=80 and current<80. CRSI is new unrounded prior-100-return-rank formula, NOT the live current-inclusive legacy CRSI.
entryRules.roc_cross: Long previous ROC5<=0 and current>0; short previous>=0 and current<0.
entryRules.vwap_cross: Long previous close<=its UTC-day VWAP and current close>current same-day VWAP; symmetric short. Require both hourly bars within the SAME UTC day to avoid reset crosses.
entryRules.clock: Initial entry first00:00/12:00 UTC whileflat, then rolling re-entry decision immediately after each timeout close fill; all orders incur declared delay. Same fixed12h hold, notional and costs. Clock is not a matched-frequency benchmark or the ladder. Cash and long buy-and-hold reported as additional context.

exitRules: fixed12h: timeout from actual fill. indicator_or12h: same timeout OR first subsequent hourly decision RSI>=50 long / <=50 short; CRSI same; ROC<=0 long / >=0 short; close<=daily VWAP long / >=short. No same-decision exit on new entry. VWAP exits may compare with the newly reset daily VWAP, explicitly unlike entry crossover. Both entry and exit market actions get the declared delay, including timeout. No TP/SL or intrabar fill assumptions.
stateRules: One position per standalone policy, fixed notional without compounding or ladder adds. Crossings are evaluated once per closed hour, ignored while occupied/pending and never queued for later; a new cross is needed after close. Pending actions fill only at their exact scheduled contiguous minute open; no retroactive fills. End inventory is marked at last close less hypothetical closing fee, not counted as a completed trade. Clock reopens after each close; signal rules still require a new hourly cross.
preRunReviewAmendment: Before loading results, independent review identified that strict00/12-only clock entries plus1m delay skip every other12h slot. Clock revised to rolling re-entry after close, preserving comparable exposure; no strategy signal/threshold change and no results inspected before amendment.
responseStudy: Non-overlap-in-time NOT assumed: compare 12h forward next-open-to-exit-open returns and minute MAE/MFE for each hourly signal against ALL eligible hours (same side/horizon); matched expected response conditions on known calendar month and current ROC5 sign. Include exit open but not exit minute's later high/low. Label correlated overlapping outcomes descriptive, not executable portfolio PnL. Freeze ADX bins <20/20-25/>=25, ATR% <1/1-2/>=2, RVOL <1/1-2/>=2 for descriptive stratification only.
researchScreen: At least30 closed full trades and10 recent, positive net and positive delta versus same-side clock in both windows and both delays, every monthly marked delta nonnegative vs clock, positive fixed-path+5bps/side stress net. Indicator-exit variants additionally report delta vs their own fixed12h rule; no automatic promotion. Funding and untouched forward validation remain unresolved even if screening passes.
baselineBoundary: This is NOT a ladder replay or a percentage improvement to the ladder. Canonical candle loader/repair reused, but standalone accounting/control independently tested. Four canonical ladder PnL reproductions remain mandatory before stage3; no unnecessary ladder sweep here.
selectionLimit: All history previously mined; windows overlap and are not added together. No post-result threshold expansion. Trade thresholds here are first-batch hypotheses, not claimed optimal settings.
